references.title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
confirmed_observations: The service prioritizes reporting cybercrime and separates financial fraud from other reporting routes.
The page exposes the official 1930 helpline and cybercrime.gov.in as urgent financial-fraud actions.
The inspected page reported a last-updated date of 05/06/2026.
All 35 extracted raster assets were visually inspected; most are official identity, social icons, institutional event photos, or prohibited fear-based cyber stock.
inferred_principles: Urgent official action must precede concept onboarding.
Task wording should be citizen-facing before legal or procedural detail.
unknowns: Authenticated NCRP form behavior was not inspected.
references.copyright_note: Internal research evidence only; no third-party asset may ship.

references.title: GOV.UK Design System
confirmed_observations: The system uses direct headings, high-contrast actions, and restrained component geometry.
Navigation and content remain legible when reflowed to a narrow viewport.
inferred_principles: Prefer progressive disclosure and one clear decision per form step.
Validation should be summarized and linked back to fields.
unknowns: The current project did not inspect authenticated service implementations.
references.copyright_note: Patterns only; do not clone identity.

references.title: Singapore Government Design System
references.source_role: mobile public-service system and media treatment
confirmed_observations: The system balances institutional navigation with warmer editorial modules.
Four photographic raster assets were visually inspected for landing-page composition; ten SVG or icon system assets are preserved and intentionally deferred.
inferred_principles: A public-service interface can feel contemporary without decorative technology motifs.
Editorial media should support task comprehension rather than sit as a generic hero.
unknowns: Downstream service transaction patterns were not inspected.
references.copyright_note: Extracted files are internal evidence only.

references.title: U.S. Web Design System
references.source_role: federal accessibility, trust, and component guidance
confirmed_observations: The system makes trust and accessibility guidance explicit instead of relying on visual authority.
The layout uses predictable reading order and conspicuous focusable actions.
inferred_principles: The independent-concept disclaimer should be structural, not buried in a footer.
Trust language should say what the prototype cannot do.
unknowns: Agency-specific adaptations were outside this inspection.

references.title: NHS Design System
references.source_role: high-stress service content and form calmness
confirmed_observations: The system uses plain language, generous vertical spacing, and clear task boundaries.
Visual emphasis is reserved for decisions and safety-critical information.
inferred_principles: Calmness comes from editing and pacing, not muted contrast.
Supporting guidance should sit adjacent to the decision it affects.

references.title: UX4G
confirmed_observations: The site exposes practical HTML component examples for Indian public-service interfaces.
Its examples emphasize visible labels, simple controls, and responsive behavior.
inferred_principles: Use locally familiar official-action language without imitating a government identity.
Semantic HTML can support the entire deterministic prototype.
unknowns: The inspected examples do not establish service-specific content quality.

references.title: Scamwatch report a scam
confirmed_observations: The page separates immediate safety action from preparing and submitting a report.
Users are told what to gather before entering the reporting route.
inferred_principles: Place urgent action and reporting preparation in distinct visual zones.
Route by what happened before asking for detailed evidence.
unknowns: A real report was not submitted.

references.title: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau complaint
references.source_role: financial complaint preflight and after-submission expectations
confirmed_observations: The page answers common preflight questions before presenting the start action.
It explains the complaint process and what happens after submission.
inferred_principles: Set expectations before asking for effort.
Explain post-submission next actions without implying guaranteed outcomes.
unknowns: Authenticated complaint entry was not inspected.

references.title: ReportFraud assistant
confirmed_observations: The assistant begins with broad incident categories and a visible progress indicator.
The first screen limits simultaneous decisions.
inferred_principles: A stressed user benefits from bounded choices.
Progress should communicate position without pretending certainty.
unknowns: The full live submission was not exercised.

references.title: IdentityTheft.gov
confirmed_observations: The service explains a three-part mechanism: tell what happened, receive a plan, take action.
Recovery is presented as a sequence rather than a dashboard.
inferred_principles: A short service model can reduce uncertainty before form entry.
Next actions should be actionable and ordered.
unknowns: Personalized plan output was not generated.

references.title: Service NSW
confirmed_observations: The homepage mixes service navigation with restrained contextual imagery.
Tasks remain more prominent than media.
inferred_principles: Use images as orientation, not as the interaction surface.
unknowns: The site was not retained because its broad-service scope is less relevant than reporting references.

user_supplied_selected.title: Safer Digital India screen reference
confirmed_observations: The photographed screen uses a two-level navigation, wide light hero, large navy headline, and four simple action columns.
The hero combines a strong left visual field with a right-aligned message and a subtle halftone background.
The visible identity includes ministry styling, the Indian flag, monument silhouettes, patriotic accents, and authority-oriented claims.
inferred_principles: Use the split composition, decisive headline scale, quiet patterned field, and four-action rhythm.
Keep the opening unmistakably civic in seriousness while explicitly identifying the prototype as independent.
unknowns: The original author, source URL, license, and whether this is an official implementation or a concept are unknown.

user_supplied_selected.title: Civic Evidence Service v1 — ten-board reference set
user_supplied_selected.source_role: user-approved visual specification and measurement source
confirmed_observations: All ten originals are 1672 by 941 pixels and were inspected at original detail.
The set defines one institutional shell across the hero, reporting process, evidence guidance, flow pages, tracker, guides, and footer.
The recurring geometry uses a 101–110px navy header, broad white surfaces, restrained blue structure, urgent red only for official action, and 12–16px radii.
Photography is warm, documentary, desk-based, and tightly connected to reporting or evidence preparation.
inferred_principles: Use the boards as measured composition references while keeping essential UI as semantic HTML.
Correct authority and outcome claims without weakening the calm institutional hierarchy.
Keep evidence and chronology as the signature mechanism across landing and flow pages.
unknowns: The boards do not establish a license for their embedded imagery or icons, so none may ship.
Generated photography remains subject to visual approval and may require a V2.
